label: Teltonika RUT142 (RS232)
description: Industrial router with RS232: 1x 100 Mbps WAN, 1x 100 Mbps LAN.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT142 datasheet: **1x WAN and 1x LAN, 10/100 Mbps**, with an **RS232** port for serial telemetry. The serial port is the reason to buy it; the two fast-Ethernet ports are the reason not to put it in front of a gigabit link. The **RS232 port is recorded here rather than as an interface: the catalogue models network interfaces, and a serial bus is neither an Ethernet port nor a radio.
